run_sft_vlm_trainer: run supervised fine-tuning on a vision-language model using TRL with accelerate launch
create_sft_trainer_vlm: create an SFTTrainer with a vision-language model, dataset, and PEFT configuration for fine-tuning
build_quantized_vlm_model: build a quantized vision-language model with device map and quantization config from model args
test_load_dataset_vlm: test loading a multimodal dataset for vision-language model training with dataset config
run_peft_lora_vlm: run PEFT LoRA fine-tuning on a vision-language model with specified target modules
